title: The Wandering Briar
kicker: A mile-long living briar wall that blocks routes, shelters Wanderer families, and moves faster when its thorns taste blood.
hook: A mile-long living briar wall that blocks routes, shelters Wanderer families, and moves faster when its thorns taste blood.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Wandering Briar is a living wall with memory in its thorns, sheltering some people and punishing anyone who treats it like brush.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: A living wall of thorn a mile long, and it moves. The way in looks like a plant trying to be a doorway. Old cart-panels and dragged doors make private rooms in the hollows. The ground shows long skid-marks where the whole thing relocated itself, and the path...

blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place mice in wall hollows small birds using thorns as protection insects that clean sap wounds No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade, or route interests Food, tools, route...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: The Wanderer families share what the Briar provides, thorn-fruit that opens only after a fight, bitter greens, snared game. A welcomed guest eats from the same pot as everyone else. An unwelcome one finds the thorns...
